description: This file defines functions and data structures for managing accounting dimensions and filters in the ERPNext system, including setup, fetching, and updating dimension filters.

classes.name: erpnext.accounts.dimensions
classes.description: Object containing methods for setting up, fetching, and updating accounting dimension filters.

methods.name: setup_dimension_filters
methods.description: Initializes dimension filters by fetching custom dimensions and setting up filters.

methods.name: fetch_custom_dimensions
methods.description: Fetches custom accounting dimensions from the server.

methods.name: setup_filters
methods.description: Sets up filters for each accounting dimension based on document type.

methods.name: setup_child_filters
methods.description: Configures filters for child tables related to dimensions.

methods.name: setup_account_filters
methods.description: Sets up account-specific filters for a dimension.

methods.name: update_dimension
methods.description: Updates dimension values for a form, especially on new documents.

methods.name: copy_dimension_from_first_row
methods.description: Copies dimension values from the first row of a table to other rows.
